title: Concept: Remote content fetched from a computed URL in php — review required
description: In php, file_get_contents is given a value rather than a literal path. The function speaks many wrappers, including http, ftp and phar, so the same call can read local files or fetch remote ones. No egress policy is applied, and the default timeouts are generous enough to scan internal ranges.
applicability: php applications that read remote resources.
risk: Internal service access and metadata retrieval; MEDIUM severity.
